Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.label_zh: 去除“预防性叠甲”防御句式示意
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.before_zh: 虽然本研究样本量有限且可能无法完全推广到所有场景，但需要指出的是，我们的初步探索或许仍在一定程度上为该领域提供了有价值的参考。
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.after_zh: 基于 3 所三甲医院的 412 例纵向队列，本模型在院内 30 天再入院预测上取得 0.84 AUROC；跨地区基层医疗队列的外部效度将在后续多中心采样中检验。
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.before_en: Although it should be noted that our sample is somewhat limited and may not generalize everywhere, this preliminary attempt still offers potentially useful insights.
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.after_en: Evaluated on a 412-patient cohort across three tertiary hospitals, the model reaches 0.84 AUROC for 30-day readmission; external validity in primary-care clinics warrants multi-site follow-up.
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.takeaway_zh: 砍掉“需要指出的是 / 或许在一定程度上”等退缩套话，直接陈述证据边界与明确的后续验证方向。
Adkid-Zephyr/anti-defensive-writing-Skil.takeaway_en: Strips hedging filler and states exact cohort boundaries alongside concrete follow-up scope.

AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.label_zh: 消除典型 AI 套话并保留学术声线
AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.before_zh: In the rapidly evolving landscape of deep learning, this study delves into the intricate interplay between data quality and scaling, not only shedding light on bottlenecks but also paving the way for future breakthroughs.
AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.after_zh: We measure how label noise alters compute-optimal scaling across 14 checkpoints (70M–7B parameters), showing that 10% corrupted labels double the tokens required to reach target validation loss.

AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.after_en: We measure how label noise alters compute-optimal scaling across 14 checkpoints (70M–7B parameters), showing that 10% corrupted labels double the tokens required to reach target validation loss.

AIScientists-Dev/academic-humanizer.takeaway_en: Removes LLM clichés ('delves into', 'paving the way') while preserving concrete experimental variables.

Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.label_zh: 摘要四要素结构重组示意
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.before_zh: 近年来长文本大模型越来越重要。本文提出了一种新的 KV 缓存压缩算法，做了很多实验，在多个数据集上效果都很好，代码也将开源。
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.after_zh: 【痛点】长上下文推理受限于 KV 缓存显存线性膨胀。【方法】本文提出层级驱逐策略 HierKV，按跨层注意力熵动态保留关键词元。【结果】在 LongBench 16 项任务上节省 62% 显存且精度损失 < 0.5%。
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.before_en: Long-context LLMs are very popular recently. We propose a new KV-cache compression algorithm and run many experiments showing good results across datasets.
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.after_en: [Bottleneck] KV-cache memory grows linearly in long-context decoding. [Method] HierKV prunes tokens dynamically via cross-layer attention entropy. [Result] Cuts memory by 62% on LongBench within 0.5% accuracy.
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.takeaway_zh: 将流水账式简介重组为“具体瓶颈 → 核心机制 → 可核验指标”的标准学术摘要骨架。
Master-cai/Research-Paper-Writing-Skills.takeaway_en: Transforms generic summaries into a crisp Bottleneck → Mechanism → Quantified Result structure.

Moonlit-Pages/AIGC-Detector-Rewriter-Ski.takeaway_en: Replaces formulaic parallelisms and slogan-like endings with sample period, estimate, and mechanism.

hanlulong/econ-writing-skill.label_zh: 经济学因果识别严谨表述改写
hanlulong/econ-writing-skill.before_zh: 表 3 的 OLS 回归系数显著为正（p<0.01），证明了高铁开通直接导致沿线城市服务业全要素生产率大幅提高。
hanlulong/econ-writing-skill.after_zh: 以历史铁路规划网构造工具变量并控制城市—年份固定效应后（表 3 第 4 列），高铁接入与服务业 TFP 提升 4.2%（SE = 1.3%）一致，排除了预期选址的内生性偏误。
hanlulong/econ-writing-skill.before_en: The significant OLS coefficient in Table 3 (p<0.01) proves that high-speed rail directly causes a large increase in service-sector TFP.
hanlulong/econ-writing-skill.after_en: Instrumenting with historical route plans under city and year fixed effects (Table 3, Col. 4), high-speed rail access is associated with a 4.2% higher service TFP (SE = 1.3%), mitigating endogenous placement.
hanlulong/econ-writing-skill.takeaway_zh: 避免将相关性误写为“证明因果”，明确交代识别策略、固定效应、标准误与排他的竞争性解释。
hanlulong/econ-writing-skill.takeaway_en: Avoids overclaiming causality from OLS; foregrounds IV strategy, fixed effects, standard errors, and threats.
